ai_summary.key_headline: El Tri's Flank Attacks Collide with Son's Speed in High-Octane Clash

mexico.philosophy: High-possession positional play utilizing inverted wingers and overlapping fullbacks.

south_korea.philosophy: Highly disciplined mid-block with rapid direct counter-attacking transitions.

tactical_insights: Luis Chavez will try to unlock South Korea's defense with deep diagonal switches to the wingers.
Son Heung-min's inside runs from the left will target Mexico's right fullback in isolated transitions.
Edson Alvarez's presence in the pivot will be crucial to halt South Korea's direct central counters.
